svg.text: GCC Database System - User Journey Flows

g.text: • Enter search terms (company name, product, certificate number)
• Filter by certificate type, status, expiration date
• Sort results by relevance, date, company
• Click certificate to view detailed information
• Single sign-on authentication via Azure AD B2C
• View company dashboard with certificate statistics
• Upload supporting documents and test reports
• Monitor application status and review feedback
Admin User Journey - Certificate Review & Approval
• Access admin dashboard with pending applications queue
• Review application details, supporting documents, and test results
• Verify compliance with certification standards and requirements
• Make approval decision or request additional information
• Generate official certificate or provide detailed feedback for revisions
• Verify green claims for LEED projects
